summary: GSK plc (NYSE: GSK) filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Nuvalent, Inc. (NASDAQ: NUVL) for $10.6 billion. The deal includes two late-stage ROS1 (zidesamtinib) and ALK (neladalkib) inhibitors for non-small cell lung cancer, under FDA review with target decision dates in September and November 2026, respectively, plus a phase I HER2 inhibitor and preclinical assets. The acquisition is expected to be accretive to sales and core operating profit in 2027 and core EPS in 2029. GSK will pay a fixed cash price per share; the exact per-share price and premium were not stated. The boards of both companies have approved the transaction. The all-cash deal is subject to regulatory approvals and Nuvalent shareholder approval, with expected close later in 2026. Watch for FDA decisions on the two lead assets, which are pivotal to the deal's value, and any competing bids or regulatory hurdles.
